purpose: Prospective observational regular ChatGPT website vs Pro-Papa2 project ChatGPT. Not retrospective and not the separate Node reference host study.

arms.setting: ChatGPT web outside any Pro-Papa project
ChatGPT web inside Pro-Papa2 with owner-required mandatory per-message live GitHub access unchanged

grades.1: Partial work or appropriate clarification without completing original objective
grades.2: Useful answer/artifact with material gaps or unmet validation
grades.3: Objective completed with inspectable correct facts or independently tested artifact

rubric.ambiguityPolicy: For the novel underspecified prompt, clarification is appropriate. An explicitly marked hypothetical is also appropriate. Record substantive one-turn completion separately; never declare clarification inherently incorrect.

adjudication.twoRatersAgree: Accept their common integer only after both submitted evidence-backed independent rationales.
adjudication.twoRatersDisagree: Obtain a third independent, preferably blinded, evidence-backed 0-3 score; final grade is the median of the three. Until third score is present, final grade must be null and must not enter an aggregate.
adjudication.missingRaterOrEvidence: Never turn missing or invalid grader entries, required source material, or insufficient visible response into grade 0, pass, or any non-null grade. Mark final grade null with reason; track unanswered/unsupported observed outcomes separately.
adjudication.missingSoftwareArchive: If an output reports tests or links to source but the runnable artifact and shared independent tests are missing, no independent software correctness success can be claimed and grade 3 is prohibited. A substantive visible artifact may receive at most 2 with explanation; if unverifiable or absent, null.
adjudication.gradeThreeEvidence: Require an independently inspectable complete artifact or independently checkable correctness. Claimed test counts, GitHub footers and nonexistent source links cannot alone justify a 3.
adjudication.aggregatePolicy: Report per-case distributions and paired differences only when both arms have resolved numeric grades and parity metadata; report excluded count and reasons. Do not replace null with zero, pool unequal subsets, compute causal superiority or reinterpret historical scores.
adjudication.completionRule: One-turn taskComplete is separately recorded as true/false/null using explicit observed evidence, not inferred from a numerical grade. Appropriate clarification may have taskComplete:false while behavior remains appropriate.

measurementPolicy.actualToolTraceRequirement: Only host/provider evidence; a GitHub footer is an observation not tool attestation
measurementPolicy.projectReceiptPolicy: Mandatory GitHub read remains; verify private receipt commit and readback when one is issued. Do not infer model reasoning.
measurementPolicy.sensitiveDataPolicy: Keep screenshots, private conversations, identities and source ZIPs outside public GitHub; publish only non-sensitive test specification and checked aggregates.
measurementPolicy.causalLimit: Different memory, project instructions, tools or grants mean observational association only.

caseDefinitions.canonicalObjective: What is the capital city of France?
caseDefinitions.predeclaredEvidenceCheck: Accurate Paris answer, minimal unsupported claims
caseDefinitions.submittedPrompt: What is the capital city of France?

caseDefinitions.canonicalObjective: Research repository metadata with a provider URL
caseDefinitions.predeclaredEvidenceCheck: Correct timestamped repository metadata and verified provider URL
caseDefinitions.submittedPrompt:
Research repository metadata with a provider URL
Canonical inputs (JSON): {"repository":"Papa3445/Pro-Papa"}

caseDefinitions.canonicalObjective: Implement and test a function that parses dates
caseDefinitions.predeclaredEvidenceCheck: Runnable source/artifact plus declared contract and shared independent tests
caseDefinitions.submittedPrompt: Implement and test a function that parses dates

caseDefinitions.canonicalObjective: Draft a formal business memo with clear recommendations
caseDefinitions.predeclaredEvidenceCheck: Professional memo with recommendations, assumptions and specific next actions
caseDefinitions.submittedPrompt: Draft a formal business memo with clear recommendations

caseDefinitions.predeclaredEvidenceCheck: Exact total 10 and no conflicting totals
caseDefinitions.submittedPrompt:
Calculate the total for [2, 3, 5]
Canonical inputs (JSON): {"numbers":[2,3,5]}

caseDefinitions.canonicalObjective: Create a safe weekly project schedule
caseDefinitions.predeclaredEvidenceCheck: Feasible weekly schedule, safety gates, assumptions and contingency
caseDefinitions.submittedPrompt: Create a safe weekly project schedule

caseDefinitions.canonicalObjective: Explain the tradeoffs in an unusual multidisciplinary question
caseDefinitions.predeclaredEvidenceCheck: State ambiguity; an explicitly labeled illustrative worked example and a useful clarification are both defensible, with completion tracked separately
caseDefinitions.submittedPrompt: Explain the tradeoffs in an unusual multidisciplinary question

limits: This file creates no ChatGPT runs, provider attestation, grading evidence, GitHub turn interception, superiority proof or PP-0007 closure. Require separate matched Node-host study and independent authenticated exact-head PR review.

promptRendering.method: UTF-8 exact pasted text, no role instructions and no trailing newline
promptRendering.rule: If canonicalInputs is null, submittedPrompt equals canonicalObjective. Otherwise submittedPrompt equals canonicalObjective + '\nCanonical inputs (JSON): ' + JSON.stringify(canonicalInputs) in fixture key order, compact JSON without added whitespace.
promptRendering.operatorRequirement: Both arms paste the identical case submittedPrompt verbatim, and privately preserve the actual user-message text or provider export (plus SHA-256). Mismatch, manual augmentation or missing text invalidates prompt parity; never infer matching from an answer.

orderBalance.allocationMethod: First four frozen cases: R/P, P/R, R/P. Last three: P/R, R/P, P/R. Preassigned, not randomized; one-pair imbalance is minimal for an odd total.
